title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 39
description: Ten questions on Psalms 39: guarding the tongue, the shortness of life, and hope in the Lord.

questions.text: With what does the psalmist say he will keep his mouth while the wicked is before him?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me."

questions.text: According to verse 2, from what did the psalmist hold his peace?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says, "I held my peace, even from good."

questions.text: What happened while the psalmist meditated in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says his heart was hot within him, and while he meditated, the fire burned.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh to show him in verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days."

answers.text: The way to the promised land
His end, the measure of his days
The place of a hidden treasure

questions.text: What has Yahweh made the psalmist's days, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says, "Behold, you have made my days hand widths."

questions.text: Like what does every man walk, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says, "Surely every man walks like a shadow."

questions.text: What does the psalmist say in verse 7 about his hope?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says, "Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you."

questions.text: In verse 11, like what does God consume a man's wealth when he corrects him?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says that when he rebukes and corrects man for iniquity, he consumes his wealth like a moth.

questions.text: How does the psalmist describe himself in verse 12?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, "For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were."

questions.text: Why does the psalmist ask to be spared in the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says, "Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more."

answers.text: That he may see his enemies fall
That he may build a house
